questions.question: A car covers 360 km in 6 hours. What is its speed?
Convert 72 km/h into metres per second.
questions.explanation: To convert km/h into m/s, multiply by 5/18. Therefore, 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s.

questions.question: A person travels equal distances at 40 km/h and 60 km/h. What is the average speed for the complete journey?
questions.explanation: For equal distances, average speed = 2xy/(x+y). Therefore, average speed = (2 × 40 × 60)/(40 + 60) = 48 km/h.

questions.question: Two vehicles are 300 km apart and travel towards each other at 40 km/h and 60 km/h. After how many hours will they meet?
questions.explanation: Since the vehicles move in opposite directions, relative speed = 40 + 60 = 100 km/h. Meeting time = 300/100 = 3 hours.

questions.question: A car travelling at 70 km/h is 60 km behind a bus travelling at 50 km/h in the same direction. How long will the car take to catch the bus?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 70 − 50 = 20 km/h. Catching time = Initial gap / Relative speed = 60/20 = 3 hours.

questions.question: A 180-metre-long train moves at 54 km/h. How long will it take to cross a pole?
questions.explanation: 54 km/h = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s. To cross a pole, the train covers its own length. Time = 180/15 = 12 seconds.

questions.question: A 150-metre-long train moving at 54 km/h crosses a platform 300 metres long. How long does it take to cross the platform completely?
questions.explanation: Total distance = Train length + Platform length = 150 + 300 = 450 metres. Speed = 54 km/h = 15 m/s. Time = 450/15 = 30 seconds.

questions.question: Two trains of lengths 120 metres and 180 metres move in opposite directions at 54 km/h and 36 km/h. How long will they take to cross each other completely?
questions.explanation: Total length = 120 + 180 = 300 metres. Relative speed = 54 + 36 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s. Time = 300/25 = 12 seconds.

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/h and the speed of the stream is 3 km/h. How long will the boat take to travel 45 km downstream?
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = Boat speed + Stream speed = 12 + 3 = 15 km/h. Time = 45/15 = 3 hours.

questions.question: A boat travels downstream at 18 km/h and upstream at 10 km/h. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.explanation: Speed of the boat in still water = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed)/2 = (18 + 10)/2 = 14 km/h.
